reason: The policy farms controlled_descent_bonus and touchdown_stability_bonus without approaching the pad. This revision makes the controlled_descent_bonus conditional on being very close to the pad (x^2+y^2 < 0.1) to prevent farming at a distance, and adds a strong progress bonus for reducing distance to the pad to incentivize approach. The progress bonus is a per-step improvement bonus that rewards getting closer to the pad, with a scale of 0.5 * (previous_distance - current_distance) to provide a clear gradient. The touchdown_stability_bonus is kept as repeatable but its condition is tightened to require being on the pad (x^2+y^2 < 0.1) to prevent farming on sloped terrain.
preserved_design: progress_shaping (distance and angle penalties) with same scales
velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
changed_design: Tighten controlled_descent_bonus condition: require x^2+y^2 < 0.1 (instead of < 0.5) to prevent farming at a distance from the pad.
Tighten touchdown_stability_bonus condition: require x^2+y^2 < 0.1 (instead of no position constraint) to ensure the lander is on the pad, not just on sloped terrain.

Add progress_bonus: +0.5 * (previous_distance - current_distance) if distance decreased, else 0. This provides a strong per-step incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start via hasattr check.
Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.1 to provide a stronger gradient for approaching the pad.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: instead, we condition the existing bonus on being very close to the pad.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we add a progress bonus and increase the distance penalty scale.
Do not make bonuses one-shot (failed pattern from iter_002): instead, we keep them repeatable but tighten the conditions to prevent farming.
action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The progress bonus will encourage more use of orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The tightened controlled_descent_bonus condition will reduce farming of main engine (action 2) when far from the pad.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): progress_bonus provides a strong gradient to move toward the pad, and increased distance penalty provides additional incentive. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (now requires being very close to pad) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (now requires being on pad) rewards low velocity at contact. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is per-step conditioned on being very close to the pad (x^2+y^2 < 0.1) and upright, so it cannot be farmed at a distance. touchdown_stability_bonus is per-step conditioned on being on the pad (x^2+y^2 < 0.1) with low velocities, so it cannot be farmed on sloped terrain. progress_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it diminishes as the lander approaches the pad. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
